systematicSign.rule: FAIL when the sign is lopsided beyond a two-sided sign test at p < 0.001, AND the median absolute difference exceeds the Target's own median repeatability, AND the direction is one this landmark's gate type treats as a defect.
systematicSign.whatWasWrongBefore: the M1 gate applied the one-sided rule per cell and a plain two-sided sign test here, so being smoother than the Target in every cell was reported as a systematic FAIL. Three landmarks failed that way; none was a defect.
